meta.title: Planning Desk
meta.description: Manage eight game-planning subagents from the left sidebar and enable each discipline on demand.

nav.label: Planning Desk
page.title: Game Development Planning Desk
page.subtitle: Eight planning subagents in one workspace. Enable the disciplines you need and keep systems, combat, content and presentation moving together.
page.saved: Switch states are written to the DSH subagent roster (~/.dsh/subagents).
role.system.name: Systems Design
role.system.desc: Breaks down the core loop and system boundaries into rules, states and clean module contracts.
role.combat.name: Combat Design
role.combat.desc: Shapes combat pacing, abilities and feedback so every encounter offers a clear decision and feel.
role.level.name: Level Design
role.level.desc: Plans space, enemies and event pacing to turn gameplay goals into a playable level flow.
role.numeric.name: Numeric Design
role.numeric.desc: Builds progression, drop and difficulty curves that keep player investment and reward in balance.
role.economy.name: Economy Design
role.economy.desc: Designs resource sinks and sources that keep the long-term economy stable and monetization fair.
role.narrative.name: Narrative Design
role.narrative.desc: Builds the world, characters and quest text so the story sits naturally inside player action.
role.engineering.name: Engineering Review
role.engineering.desc: Reviews requirements and system implementation for technical risk, dependencies and delivery cost.
role.art.name: Art Review
role.art.desc: Maps visual style, asset and motion needs so art direction serves both gameplay and narrative.
